purpose: PRD-09 usage reader fixture: a real Claude Code headless run, Anthropic Messages over HTTP with SSE responses carrying token usage

claude-code-2.1.283-e01.jsonl.line_format: the same line format as m2-openai/codex-0.153.0-ws-run.jsonl: one JSON object per stream in Open order: stream (Open-order number), source, exchange, method (requests) or status (responses), content_type, label, first and last (wall time of the first segment's first and the last segment's last observation), text (the retained bytes as UTF-8). Host api.anthropic.com and path /v1/messages are common to every stream and not repeated.
claude-code-2.1.283-e01.jsonl.conversion: Converted in a build box from the old v5 chain-shaped lines (open, segment and end records). For each stream, its segments' text was joined in source_offset order (the offsets were checked to be contiguous in source coordinates). The retained text is kept as recorded: stream 1 keeps the two <redacted:email> masks, so its text is 3958 bytes for 3963 source bytes. Dropped: producer and connection ids, mono_ns, clock_id, protocol_hint, part numbers, per-segment offsets and lengths, redaction audit spans and the end records (all four ended with reason complete). No response header naming a request id (request-id) was present in the source metadata, so the lines carry none; the id join reads it only when a recording has it. The conversion script is not committed.
claude-code-2.1.283-e01.jsonl.checked_in_box: every line parses as JSON; both response streams' text contains a message_start event and a message_delta event, each with a usage object (exchange 1: input 10, cache creation 7637, cache read 13689, output 356 at message_delta; exchange 2: input 8, cache creation 511, cache read 21326, output 61 at message_delta)

source.harness: Claude Code 2.1.283 (versions/2.1.283, sha256 d8cb1e5c...5651d21e per E01), headless, --model haiku
source.protocol: Anthropic Messages over HTTP/1.1: POST api.anthropic.com /v1/messages (application/json), 200 text/event-stream responses; request 2 is a threaded continuation (thread.type continue, previous_message_id) carrying only the two tool_result blocks
source.capture: T13 proxy, T04 stream redaction, T03 v5 writer; decoded body bytes (chunked framing removed by T10)

streams.changes: re-serialized after eliding system texts, metadata.user_id, tool descriptions and input_schemas, and five long unredacted system-reminder text blocks; split at the system member
same-length placeholders for the message and tool-use IDs and the thinking signature; every part keeps its real length, offset and boundary
re-serialized after eliding the system (billing header) text and metadata.user_id; ID placeholders
same-length placeholders for the message ID and the thinking signature

placeholders.provider IDs: msg_/toolu_/req_ + PLACEHOLDER + zero-padded ordinal, same length as the original, mapped consistently in chain order (msg_PLACEHOLDER0000000000001 is response 1's message and request 2's thread.previous_message_id)
placeholders.thinking signature: repeated 'elided-signature-' cut to the original length
placeholders.elided values: <elided: N bytes> with the original UTF-8 length; tool input_schema {}

observed_protocol_set.not_observed: error events, JSON error documents, other blocks and deltas: synthetic tests only

checks.redact_py: spikes/redact.py: 0 redactions on the fixture and on derive.py; output byte-identical
checks.needle_scan: 0 hits for the e-mail addresses and organizationUuid of the raw native transcript copy, the account_uuid, device_id and session_id of the raw request metadata, the billing-header cc_prompt_id/cc_prev_req/cch values, every original msg_/toolu_/req_ ID and both original thinking signatures
checks.patterns: 0 '@', 0 UUID-shaped strings, 0 'sk-', 0 'Bearer', 0 JWT prefixes, 0 refresh_token, 0 proxy credentials, 0 long base64 runs; the one '/Users/' match is the Read tool's split path fragment '/Users/' + 'Shared/goalcup-' (the shared run directory, not a home path)
checks.eye_review: every record read; kept request text: the goal, the total_tokens and date reminders, and the userEmail and attribution reminders whose addresses T04 had already replaced with <redacted:email>; the tool_result contents (including the harness-appended total_tokens system-reminder on the Read result) and the SSE input_json_delta fragments keep the shared run path /Users/Shared/goalcup-m2-e01/<run> (not personal data)

not_copied: derive.py (the old derivation script) and the v5 record wrapper fields listed under conversion

secret_scan.covers: sk-, sk-ant-, sk-proj-, ghp_, gho_, github_pat_, xox?-, AKIA keys, Bearer followed by a non-mask value, eyJ JWT starts, -----BEGIN blocks, 40+ character hex or base64 runs next to key, token, secret, authorization or password names; case-insensitive, so it over-matches rather than under-matches
secret_scan.where: a build box (box.mjs) on the committed branch, not on the conductor
